one_liner: Cloudflare developer platform and global network APIs for managing DNS, Workers, R2, and edge services.
access_notes: Developers can sign up for a free account and generate API tokens or global keys directly from the dashboard.
verdict_reason: Cloudflare provides fully self-serve API credentials, comprehensive REST endpoints, and official Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers.

evidence.snippet: Global API key is the previous authorization scheme for interacting with the Cloudflare API. When possible, use API tokens instead of Global API key.
From the Cloudflare dashboard ↗︎, go to My Profile > API Tokens for user tokens. For Account Tokens, go to Manage Account > API Tokens.
